title: Aisha's party: everything mixed
instructions: Statements, questions, requests and commands: report what people said about Aisha's party. The beginning is already there.

items.direct: Aisha to Mila: "I'm having a party on Saturday."
items.answer: Aisha told Mila (that) she was having a party on Saturday.
Aisha asked Mila [if|whether] she could come.
items.hint: Yes/no question → if / whether. can → could

items.answer: Aisha told Mila to bring her camera.

items.direct: Mila to Mrs Moreno: "Can I go to Aisha's party?"
items.answer: Mila asked Mrs Moreno [if|whether] she could go to Aisha's party.
items.hint: Yes/no question. I → she, can → could

items.direct: Mrs Moreno to Mila: "Diego will drive you there."
items.answer: Mrs Moreno told Mila (that) Diego would drive her there.

items.direct: Mrs Moreno to Mila: "Don't stay too long."
items.answer: Mrs Moreno told Mila not to stay too long.

items.direct: Diego to Mila: "What time does the party start?"
items.answer: Diego asked Mila what time the party started.

items.direct: Mila: "I have bought a present for Aisha."
items.answer: Mila said (that) she had bought a present for Aisha.

items.direct: Tyler to Mila (at the party): "Did you make the cake?"
items.answer: Tyler asked Mila [if|whether] she had made the cake.

items.direct: Mila: "Sofia and I baked it yesterday."
items.answer: Mila said (that) [Sofia and she|she and Sofia] had baked it [the day before|the previous day].
items.hint: I → she, baked → had baked, yesterday → the day before

items.direct: Aisha to her guests: "Please take a piece of cake."
items.answer: Aisha asked her guests to take a piece of cake.
Diego said (that) they had to leave( then).
items.hint: Statement: we → they, must → had to, now → then
